title: Bidriware Silver Inlay Surahi Vase
description: Blackened zinc-copper alloy hand-chiselled and inlaid with pure 99.9% silver wire tendrils, oxidized using 15th-century Bidar fort soil.

title: Channapatna Wooden Stacking Dolls & Figures
description: Lathe-turned ivory softwood (Aale mara) hand-burnished with non-toxic, child-safe natural vegetable lacquer and turmeric/indigo extracts.

title: Hand-Sculpted Kinhal Painted Chowki Deities
description: Lightweight seasoned wood hand-shaped with tamarind seed paste (kitta) and jute fibers, hand-painted with vivid natural tempera pigments.

title: Mysore Rosewood Inlaid Heritage Wall Panel
description: Fine Indian rosewood embedded with natural multicolored timbers and bone inlays depicting royal Dussehra processions and temple architecture.

title: Mysore Traditional 24K Gold Leaf Framed Artwork
description: Classical court-style painting featuring low-relief gesso work sculpted with zinc oxide and overlaid with pure 24-karat gold leaf foil.

title: Dashavatara Round Ganjifa Playing Cards Set
description: Hand-cut circular cards made of stiffened cloth discs, intricately hand-painted depicting the ten incarnations of Lord Vishnu.

title: Navalgund Handwoven Peacock Jamkhana Rug (4x6 ft)
description: Vertical-frame handloom flat-weave cotton durrie dyed in bold jewel tones, featuring traditional peacock (Mayura) and chess-board borders.

title: Sandur Lambani Mirror-Work Wall Hanging
description: Nomadic Banjara tribal patchwork incorporating 14 distinctive geometric needle stitches, embedded circular mirrors, and genuine cowrie shells.

title: Dharwad Handloom Pure Silk Kasuti Stole
description: Counted-thread needlework using the seamless Gavanti and Murgi stitches, forming temple chariot and lotus motifs identical on both faces.
